arena: Existing Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player three-turn-teacher fit data; no new maps or game evaluation

input.label: First legal action index of selected native three-turn complete plan at the first sampled root position per fit map

training.trainable: All parameters of the routed-v6 UniversalPolicy, unlike the prior frozen-encoder student
training.objective: Teacher first-action cross-entropy on unchanged copied observations and legal-action ordering; no source KL, augmentation, terminal reward, or student roll-in
training.optimizer: AdamW lr0.0003 weight_decay0, 16 examples per batch, 1024 deterministic updates, gradient norm clip1.0

gate: The predeclared 95% same-snapshot memorization criterion passed by update128 and remained passed through update1024.
limitations: The first sampled position on every fit map was seat0; this probe gives no seat1 memorization evidence.
The model saw the identical 128 observations repeatedly. The result says nothing about unseen maps, student-visited states, complete-turn choices, autonomous game strength, or Elo.
This full-network no-KL diagnostic does not reproduce the prior frozen-encoder imitation recipe, so it does not isolate which ingredient caused that student's failed held-out gate.
Previously observed RNG-dependent searched labels and source/student state-distribution differences remain possible generalization boundaries. This run does not causally attribute failure to either.
qualification: Diagnostic training fit only; no neural policy promoted, rated, or deployed
